overall: MARGINAL overall: west/central fishable, east too windy
limiterDetail: Main limiter is a combination of wind and current. Wind 14–16 kt (26–30 kph, gusts 20–23) at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron, Barangonan. Current is 0.9–1.0 kt at Culion, Tara, Turda, Alava, Decabaitot; Tara/Turda pulse to 1.5–1.7 kt about 6–7 PM. Rain is minor (~1.5 mm, mostly dry). 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR (feed OK, no gale/TCWS/heavy-rain alert for Calamian/MIMAROPA; latest items are Luzon/Caraga advisories). Supporting only.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed
items: Worse than this morning: 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 9 POOR / 0 VERY POOR. Same split sea, but more grounds slipped to POOR (Culion, Alava, Turda, Tara now POOR on current ~0.9–1.0 kt). West/central Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo stay GOOD. 48h outlook downgraded: Thu 26 is now POOR / BELOW NORMAL (16 kt ≈ 30 kph, gusts 22); Wed 25 is MARGINAL (14 kt, gusts 20). No supply surge.
Supply: normal to softening through Mon 30. Shortage detector ELEVATED (guide only). PAGASA is CLEAR for Calamian/MIMAROPA. Season ends about 6 Dec.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight 6–11 PM, west and central grounds
details: Wind is lowest tonight (Coron/Galoc about 1–4 kt from 6 PM, east grounds ease to 11–12 kt by 11 PM) and rises again after 6 AM Wed, to 13–14 kt by 1 PM. Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo are the best grounds. Tara/Turda current pulses 1.5–1.7 kt around 6–7 PM; Decabaitot, Barangonan and Alava pulse after midnight. Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan.
